chapter.skyabyss.aftermath.titan_ember: The ash has stopped. One beat sounded, a little late.
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.ch4_draug: Gave two fire-ward draughts. Show them to the artisan
Counted the draughts as shown to the artisan
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.ch4_forge: Recorded the forge page. Show it to the storyteller
Counted the forge page as shown to the storyteller
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.ch4_pit: Moved you to the dead forge pit. Fell the old thrall at the bottom
commands.skyabyss.playtest.now.ch4_rumor: Counted Isana's tale of the ash mountain as heard. The preparations open
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch4a_first:
So you came as far as the ash. ...Tools here are sooty and heavy.
Take these notes: how to tell the ash bugs apart, and what goes into a soot whetstone and an ash cooler. The smithy and the apothecary will make them.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch4a_ward: Rewoven with soot iron. ...Don't melt this one.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch4a_ward_offe: Lost your ember heartbeat ward? With eight soot iron, I can weave another.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch4g_draught_s:
Fire draughts. Well brewed.
Tools remember. Their owners, less so. ...Only a fire draught is remembered by the one who drinks it.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch4g_draught_t:
The ash folk drank a fire draught before entering the forge. Drink the fire, then into the fire.
The apothecaries in Hairo and the capital sell fire-resistance draughts. ...Carry two. One trip to the forge won't do.
dialogue.skyabyss.artisan.ch4t_ward_weav:
Ash ward thread. It must have been in the old thrall's pot, half woven.
I will finish it into a heartbeat ward. When your heart races in the heat, hold it.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch4_s_one: ... The ash has come down another step. My grandmother used to say the key was one, long ago.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch4_s_thre: ... A strange tale. Only an old saying. If you carry all four, at least do not drop them.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch4_s_two: Not broken in four, she said. Entrusted to four places. A broken thing mends when gathered. A thing entrusted... one goes to return it, no?
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch4g_forge:
Let me see. ..."Return four, then go down. This time."
I have seen this hand before, I am sure of it. Someone who writes "this time" has failed once already.

It says "return". Not take, not break.
...My grandmother said the same: what was left in trust is something you go to give back. You are going to give it back.

Shall I tell you of the ash people? In my grandmother's grandmother's day, a forge fire still burned in the southern ash.
There was a forge in a pit under the hills. The ash people did not burn fire there. They kept it in trust. ...An old thrall still keeps its watch, they say.

Those who keep watch do not stop when the fire dies.
...If you go, crack its shell with heat. A cold blade just sinks into ash.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch4g_road_:
The ash people measured the fallen ash with blackstone posts, they say. Walk where it lies deeper and you reach the rim of the falling ash.
...No one ever went past the rim, though.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch4g_s_kil:
You found the kiln? ..."Burn only while the hill sleeps."
Borrow the fire, then give it back. That is how the ash people lived, all along.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ms_key_fou:
The fourth line of the counting song was "four, at night the moon will come".
One, two, three, four. Each time a titan slept, I remembered one more line.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ms_key_ret:
If the key points down, then go down and give it back.
The heartbeats the four backs held in trust, back to where they came from. ...What is borrowed is given back.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.c_menu.ch: What do you make of the key?
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch4_i_one: I see it differently from the storyteller. I always thought a key was a tool for its bearer to choose with.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch4_i_thr: When you hold the fourth, I think you will know. Not what it opens, but what you were made to carry.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch4_i_two: Gather four and the door in the sky opens. I chased the whales believing that. But each one I gathered made my feet heavier. Not the key's weight.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch4g_c_bo:
That mountain sleeps at night and breathes slowly. When it breathes in, its mouth opens.
...Wait to be drawn in. If you are afraid, stay afraid. I will be here, counting, waiting.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch4g_c_dr:
Seen the bug that drags ash behind it? Chase it and it curls up and rolls away.
...As a boy I chased one and wandered into an old kiln of the ash people. It should still be there.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ch4g_c_wa:
You climbed the southern lookout? ...Only the middle of the circle glows red at night, doesn't it.
I used to think that was fire. Now I think it is breath.
dialogue.skyabyss.whale_chaser.ms_c_key3:
The old woman told you to give it back, didn't she.
...I don't know. They say the titans only sleep. But was it right to put them to sleep? They kept someone's orders all this time.
entity.skyabyss.elder_thrall.name: Old Thrall
item.skyabyss.ash_baked_bread.desc: Hard bread baked on hot ash. A full stomach settles the heat in your core too (Absorption II 60 s, −15 heat on the ember's back)
item.skyabyss.ash_cooler.desc: Drink to draw the heat from your core (-40 heat on the ember's back) and resist fire for a while (30 s)
item.skyabyss.ash_hemp.desc: Hemp that thrives even in ash. Steeped into coolers
item.skyabyss.ash_walking_armor.desc: Travel gear of soot iron plates laced with ash hemp. Heat builds up more slowly (heat on the ember's back −2.5% per piece, −10% for the set)
item.skyabyss.ash_walking_boots.story: "The warmer the ground, the deeper you sink."
item.skyabyss.ash_walking_chestplate.sto: "Whoever stands before a fire guards their front first."
item.skyabyss.ash_walking_helmet.story: "On days the ash falls, cover your mouth."
item.skyabyss.ash_ward_thread.desc: A half-woven thread from the old thrall's pot. The artisan weaves it into a heartbeat ward
item.skyabyss.lore_page.desc.ember_heart: Found at the ash people's hearth. A few lines in a hand you almost know.
item.skyabyss.soot_iron.desc: Sooty iron from the ash lands. For whetstones and reweaving a heartbeat ward
item.skyabyss.soot_whetstone.desc: Use to hone your blade (Soot Blade: +2.6 attack for 20 minutes). Deals 1.5x to ash shells
lore.skyabyss.ch4.fire_draught.body:
The traveling artisan said the ash people drank a fire draught before they entered the forge.

Inside the forge it was far hotter than any fire outside. There, the ash people reforged the fire they had borrowed.

At the bottom of every flask lay a pinch of ash, so the fire would learn their scent.
lore.skyabyss.ch4.fire_draught.title: The Ash People's Draught
lore.skyabyss.ch4.forge_page.body:
At the bottom of the dead forge pit, on a cold anvil, lay one torn page.

"Return four, then go down. This time."

The hand that wrote "this time" wrote it like a hand that had written it before. The writing looks like your own.
lore.skyabyss.ch4.forge_page.title: The Forge Page
lore.skyabyss.ch4.return_the_beat.body:
Deep in the forge hall, before it raised its hammer, the ash smith spoke low.

"Have you come to return it?"

It was not an angry voice. It was the voice of one who had been waiting.
lore.skyabyss.ch4.return_the_beat.title: Have You Come to Return It
lore.skyabyss.ch4.soot_kiln.body:
A kiln of the ash people. Above its mouth, words are cut in the stone.

"Fire the kiln only while the hill sleeps. When the hill wakes, give the fire back."

To the ash people, fire seems to have been something held in trust, not something to burn.
lore.skyabyss.ch4.soot_kiln.title: The Soot Kiln
message.skyabyss.ch4g.arrive.ch4_ash_mar: Ash gauges are cut into a blackstone post. The ash lies deeper to the south.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.arrive.ch4_ash_wat: The ashfall lookout. From here the circle of falling ash is plain to see.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.arrive.ch4_dead_fo: The mouth of the pit smells of cold iron.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.arrive.ch4_soot_ki: An old kiln of the ash people. Its mouth is black with soot.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.arrive.ch4_warm_ro: Only among the basalt pillars does the air shimmer.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.cooler.drink: The cold ash water draws the heat from your throat.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.kiln.cache: At the bottom of the kiln: sooty iron and a bundle of ash hemp.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.kiln.cache_empty: Only ash remains at the bottom of the kiln.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.kiln.dragger: The dragger rolls into the kiln's mouth. This must be its nest.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.marks.last: Only the ash on the fifth post is still warm. You have reached the rim of the falling ash.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.mite.drawn: The mites turn as one toward the warm stone in your hand.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.pit.crack: The cracks in the floor begin to pulse red.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.pit.pack: Beside the cold forge someone left a pack: one ember drop and a torch.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.pit.page: A torn page lies on the cold anvil.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.pit.stand: The basalt on the stand is worn hollow. Something warm was set here.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.pit.stand_cold: The stand is cold. A warm stone might wake it.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.pit.stand_warm: You set the warm stone on the stand. The cinder mites turn toward it.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.pit.trail: The forge the storyteller spoke of must lie at the bottom of this pit.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.pit.wave: The shell splits. Heat bursts out.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.ready: You are ready for the ash lands.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.rocks.stone: As you bring the warm stone close, the rock answers with heat. The stone in your hand gives a faint beat.
message.skyabyss.ch4g.smith.return: Before raising its hammer, the ash smith speaks low: "...Have you come to return it?"
message.skyabyss.ch4g.watch.night: Only the ground at the circle's heart glows faintly red in the night.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.aftermath.end: Far beneath your feet, a beat the same as the key's sounded once.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.aftermath.tel: ... Welcome back. Keep that key. It was we who kept looking only upward.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.beat.ground: The soil underfoot is faintly warm. Only where the frost lay, a round patch has vanished.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.beat.hum: The water in the pail is lukewarm. ... Far below, something low sounded once.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.beat.ridge: The smoke of the far hill rises from a different place than yesterday.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.rise: The hill lifted. ... What you took for a mountain is breathing.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.site.hearth: The ruin of a hearth. The ash has been raked together in the shape of a hand.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.site.ledge: Only the stones of this ledge are warm, as if a hand had rested on them.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.site.post: Ash lies thin along the marks of the post. A little higher than yesterday.
message.skyabyss.ember_ch4.warm_base: Only the ground around your bed is warm.
message.skyabyss.soot_whetstone.used: You hone the blade. A black streak of soot stays on the edge.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.ash_road.done: The nearer the circle, the deeper the ash on the posts.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.ash_road.summary: Follow five blackstone posts to the rim of the falling ash.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.ash_road.title: Marks of the Ash Road
quest.skyabyss.ch4.ash_road.trace.journa: The storyteller said the ash people walked to the rim of the falling ash, measuring how deep it lay with blackstone posts.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.ash_road.trace.marks: Follow the marks of the ash road
quest.skyabyss.ch4.dragger_trail.done: The old kiln had become the draggers' nest.
Isana said: "There is a bug that drags ash behind it. Chase it and it curls up and rolls away. Where it rolls, there was a kiln of the ash people."
Follow a dragger to the kiln
quest.skyabyss.ch4.dragger_trail.summary: Chase the ash-dragging bug to the ash people's kiln.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.dragger_trail.title: The Ash Dragger
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fire_draught.brew.jou:
The travelling artisan said: 'The ash folk drank a fire draught before the forge. Carry two. One trip won't do.'
Fire-resistance potions are sold at the apothecaries in Hairo and the capital.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fire_draught.done: "Drink fire, walk into fire. That is how the ash people entered the forge."
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fire_draught.show.jou: Two fire draughts are ready. Show them to the traveling artisan.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fire_draught.show.tal: Show the potions to the artisan
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fire_draught.summary: To prepare for the forge, get two fire-resistance potions.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fire_draught.title: The Fire Draught
quest.skyabyss.ch4.forge_ruins.done: "Return four, then go down." ...You are going to give it back, then.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.forge_ruins.pit.journ:
The storyteller said: "Under the hills of the southern ash, there is a forge of the ash people. An old thrall still keeps its fire, they say."
Fell the old thrall at the bottom of the pit and the forge will be yours to see. Ash shells crack under heat. When a crack in the floor starts to pulse red, step away.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.forge_ruins.summary: See the ash people's forge at the bottom of the dead forge pit.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.forge_ruins.tell.jour: A torn page lay on the cold anvil. Show it to the storyteller.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.forge_ruins.tell.talk: Show the forge page to the storyteller
quest.skyabyss.ch4.forge_ruins.title: The Forge Ruins
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fragments.done: Their two tales held different ends of the same key.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fragments.isana.journ: Isana, too, wants to speak of the key.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fragments.summary: Hear about the key from the storyteller and from Isana, each in their own way.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fragments.teller.jour: The ash mornings go on. The storyteller seems to want to talk about the key.
quest.skyabyss.ch4.fragments.title: The Key That Was One
quest.skyabyss.daily_ash_watch.done: The ash hemp on the drying racks should be left alone tonight.
quest.skyabyss.daily_ash_watch.summary: Defeat six ash husks roaming the ash land. Party members count too.
quest.skyabyss.daily_ash_watch.title: Night Watch on the Ash
quest.skyabyss.daily_ash_watch.unlock_hi: Talk to Isana to take this on
quest.skyabyss.daily_ash_watch.watch.jou: A note on the board, in ash-stained writing: "At night, ash husks come to tear up the ash hemp on the drying racks. Drive off six or so. They also rise in the old forging hall of the dead forge pit, even by day."
quest.skyabyss.daily_ash_watch.watch.kil: Defeat ash husks on the ash land
quest.skyabyss.daily_mite_clear.done: The fires will be quiet for a while.
quest.skyabyss.daily_mite_clear.summary: Clear ten cinder mites from the ash lands.
quest.skyabyss.daily_mite_clear.sweep.jo: A note on the board, smudged with soot: "Cinder mites keep creeping to the drying fires. Clear about ten. Carry a warm stone and they will come to you."
quest.skyabyss.daily_mite_clear.title: Mite Sweep
quest.skyabyss.main_ember.board.board: Enter its mouth as it breathes in
quest.skyabyss.main_ember.board.journal:
At night the mountain breathes slowly in its sleep. Only while it breathes in does its mouth open.
Step into that mouth and you will be carried inside its back.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_ember_heart.done: The embers have settled. But under the ash, the fire still breathes.
A note in the corner of the board, in the same unsigned hand: "The embers grow hot again in seven days. Go and make sure, before they are hot through."
quest.skyabyss.weekly_ember_heart.summar: Still the ember's heart once more. Party members in the fight count too.
quest.skyabyss.weekly_ember_heart.title: The Ember's Heart, Once More
quest.skyabyss.weekly_ember_heart.unlock: Talk to Isana to take this on
wayfarer_notes.ch4.line.1: Cinder mites: drawn to heat. Carry a warm stone and they swarm you. Set it on a stand and they go there. One hit each.
wayfarer_notes.ch4.line.2: Ash husks: half damage until the shell breaks. Then they burn, speed up, and burn out.
wayfarer_notes.ch4.line.3: Ash draggers: harmless. Chase one and it rolls away, toward the old kiln.
wayfarer_notes.ch4.line.4: Old thrall: when floor cracks pulse red, step away (they burst 1.5 s later). Breaking its shell sends out a heat wave.
wayfarer_notes.ch4.line.5: Fire-ward draught: sold by the apothecaries in Hairo and the capital.
wayfarer_notes.ch4.line.6: Soot whetstone (2 soot iron, flint) and ash cooler (2 ash hemp, bottle). The cooler lowers the heat on the back.
wayfarer_notes.ch4.line.7: Ash walking gear (soot iron, ash hemp, thunder wing shafts) slows the heat on the back. Ash-baked bread (3 wheat, ash hemp) gives absorption and cools.
